subject: Request: short-term backup purge waiver and audit hold — Acme Financial
messages:
From: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acme-fin.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Short-notice request: backup purge grace window for regulated snapshots

Mina —

We have an upcoming internal audit (scheduled Dec 15) and discovered that several of the user-level snapshots Redwood retains for Acme could be purged under our current SLA before evidence collection completes. To avoid gaps in the audit trail, can Redwood provide a short-term waiver to prevent purge of snapshots and related logs for records tagged "acme_fin_regulated" through Jan 31, 2027?

Specifically we need:
- A temporary hold (no purge) on full snapshots identified in the attached DataFlow_SnapshotMap.pdf
- Retention of debug and access logs for those snapshots for 90 days beyond the current policy, with ability to produce hashes and timestamps for audit evidence
- Confirmation of any subcontracted processors that touch these snapshots (we need names + country)

We appreciate a fast reply — procurement is asking for a written confirmation to include with our SOC2 submission.

Thanks,
Sara Hayes
Head of Security Operations
Acme Financial

Attachment: DataFlow_SnapshotMap.pdf (map of snapshots and tags)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acme-fin.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Short-notice request: backup purge grace window for regulated snapshots

Sara —

Thanks for the detail and the snapshot map. We can support a temporary hold while we coordinate internally. High-level response here so you have something for procurement:

- We can place a targeted retention hold for objects tagged "acme_fin_regulated" and prevent purge through 2027-01-31.
- We can extend log retention for the scoped objects to 180 days for operational/debug logs; access/audit logs we can export as signed artifacts on request (hash+timestamps).
- Subprocessors: the snapshot storage path may traverse our cloud partner (CloudNode) and our CDN provider (EdgeAtlas). I will confirm countries in a follow-up.

Action items for us: Marking for infra to implement targeted exemption and to prepare an evidence bundle. I am attaching our retention-exception form so legal/procurement can reference the change.

I'll loop in Markus (infra/runtime) to confirm technical feasibility and timelines, and Laura for contracts / DPA amendment language. If acceptable, we can push a short confirmation DocuSign for your procurement team today.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Trust & Risk, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-retention-exception-form.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acme-fin.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Short-notice request: backup purge grace window for regulated snapshots

Sara / team —

Quick tech summary (implementation notes):

1) Targeted snapshot hold: we support tag-based retention exemptions. Once "acme_fin_regulated" is confirmed, infra will mark those snapshots with a no-delete flag and exclude them from the scheduled purge run. Estimated work: 2 hours of change + one small migration job. Target ETA: 2026-12-03 18:00 PST.

2) Logs: we keep several log tiers — operational (hot), audit (cold), and debug. We can:
   - Export audit logs for the scoped objects as signed JSONL bundles (with SHA256) within 24 hours of request.
   - Extend debug and operational log retention for the tagged objects to 180 days (will increase storage delta; we will provide projected cost impact).

3) Subprocessors: snapshots live in CloudNode (US, primary) and secondary replication goes to EdgeAtlas (EU) for DR — both are listed in our DPA as subprocessors. We'll provide an up-to-date subprocessor table and country list for Acme's records.

4) Technical caveat: our automated purge job runs daily at 02:00 UTC. To prevent any race, please confirm scope by EOD Dec 2 and we'll gate the job for the scoped prefixes until Jan 31.

I've attached the internal runbook we'll use to implement and later reverse the exemption.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Serving Infrastructure

Attachment: backup-exempt-runbook.txt

From: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acme-fin.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Short-notice request: backup purge grace window for regulated snapshots

Team —

Thanks Markus — that approach should work. A couple of clarifying requests before we sign anything:

- Please confirm the exact prefixes / snapshot IDs to be held (we will provide internal IDs after this message)
- Can you provide the subprocessor table with country locations as a signed PDF for our DPA appendix?
- We will need a statement confirming Redwood will not replicate the held snapshots outside the listed subprocessors during the hold window.

Procurement is asking for a one-page amendment to the DPA that calls out the temporary hold dates and the log-export commitments (we will accept a DocuSign amendment). If you can provide the amendment and the subprocessor PDF today, we can route to legal and sign.

Sara

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acme-fin.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Short-notice request: backup purge grace window for regulated snapshots

Sara —

Affirmative. We will:
- Hold snapshots for prefixes you send by EOD 2026-12-02 and exclude them from the 02:00 UTC purge job through 2027-01-31.
- Produce a signed subprocessor appendix (PDF) and a one-page DPA amendment (DocuSign link) with the hold dates and log-export SLA.
- Export audit logs for the scoped objects as signed bundles on demand and commit to the 180-day debug log retention for the targeted set.

Next steps: please send the internal snapshot IDs and I will trigger the infra change. Laura will post the DocuSign amendment and the subprocessor appendix to the HubSpot deal record.

Action items (owners):
- Acme: send snapshot prefixes / IDs (owner: Sara) — deadline: EOD 2026-12-02
- Redwood Infra: implement hold after receipt (owner: Markus) — ETA: 2026-12-03 18:00 PST
- Redwood Legal/Contracts: prepare DocuSign amendment + subprocessor PDF (owner: Laura) — ETA: 2026-12-02 20:00 PST

I'll follow up with DocuSign link once Laura posts it.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Trust & Risk
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-FT-23
